title: Hyderabad's water crunch, explained
lede: El Niño gave Telangana a weak monsoon. Reservoirs and groundwater are low, power use is surging, and officials warn the drinking-water squeeze could start in December and last until July. Here's how it built up.
india: Your taps, tanker bills and power cuts. The western IT corridor (Singur) and the Old City (Osman Sagar) are most exposed.

players.name: CM Revanth Reddy
players.role: Warned the crisis may last till July; set up a Cabinet sub-committee.

players.name: HMWSSB (Water Board)
players.role: Runs supply; cutting bulk users, fining tanker wastage, planning area-wise backups.

players.name: HYDRAA
players.role: Clearing lake encroachments and illegal water theft (Sunnam Cheruvu).

players.name: El Niño
players.role: Record-hot Pacific that weakened the monsoon: 17% less rain in Telangana.

players.name: Singur & Osman Sagar
players.role: Key local sources: Singur ~11% full, Osman Sagar down to 2.2 TMC.

timeline.what: Weak rains push hundreds of mandals in Telangana and Andhra into drought.
CM warns of a water and power crisis; groundwater in parts of Hyderabad below 20 m.
With Singur ~12% full, the Water Board cuts supply to IIT-H, BHEL and others by 20–50%.
15 of 16 Hyderabad areas found critical or over-exploited for groundwater.
Singur got ~3 TMC inflow this year vs a record 237 TMC last year; officials can't meet drinking needs from December.
Water Board fines tankers ₹5,000 for wastage and cuts water and power use in its own offices.
CM: crisis may last till July. State reservoirs hold 178.6 of 470 TMC; power use up 37% in a year. HYDRAA rips out hidden pipelines at Sunnam Cheruvu.
Pacific hits a record 30.06°C as El Niño strengthens. IMD rain alert for east Telangana on Oct 28 brings some hope.
Officials fear Singur, the IT corridor's source, may run dry by mid-December (~50 days); Water Board reportedly warns of shortages from Dec 15.
Water board declares emergency over acute shortage; over half of Telangana's 600+ mandals in drought, water left in ~500 of 6,000+ lakes (Siasat, citing irrigation dept data).
HYDRAA demolishes 11 of 30+ illegal borewells selling groundwater near Sunnam Cheruvu, Guttala Begumpet (Hans India).
State to divert Godavari water to areas fed by depleting Singur and Manjira reservoirs (The Hindu). Singur had 22 days of normal supply left as of Oct 18.
